maria-devex: quick help — our CI started failing after switching the SDK to a pyproject/poetry flow. Locally `poetry install` is fine, but the CI runner (uses pip wheel install from exported reqs) hits dependency resolution errors AND our async streaming tests occasionally hang. anyone seen weird httpx/types stubs + streaming interactions? :thinking:

devin-sdk: can you paste the exact error from CI? also which httpx + httpcore versions are you pinning?

maria-devex: here's the top of the failure log (trimmed):
```
ERROR: Cannot resolve: httpx (>=0.23,<0.25) requires httpcore<0.16,>=0.15 but your lock has httpcore==0.14.2
mypy: error: "AsyncClient" has no attribute "stream"
pytest: killed while waiting for test to finish (timeout)
```

samir-ml: two quick things that sound related: (1) types packages sometimes lag and mypy will treat methods as missing if `types-httpx` doesn't match httpx version; (2) streaming hangs often mean the test loop/uvloop mismatch or a missing await on the iterator.

alex-eng: also check `poetry.lock` -> if you `poetry export -f requirements.txt` you might be dropping the extra markers or extra index pins CI expects. I usually do:
```
poetry export -f requirements.txt --with dev --without-hashes -o /tmp/reqs.txt
pip install -r /tmp/reqs.txt
```
that tends to expose mismatches early.

linh: for the mypy error, try installing a matching stub package version. e.g. if you lock httpx==0.23.3 then: `pip install types-httpx==0.23.3` (or add `types-httpx` to pyproject extras). For the hang: wrap the stream in `asyncio.wait_for` in tests to get a clearer trace:
```
async def test_stream(client):
    with pytest.raises(asyncio.TimeoutError):
        await asyncio.wait_for(_drain_stream(client), timeout=5)

async def _drain_stream(client):
    async with client.stream("generate", input=...) as s:
        async for chunk in s:
            pass
```

maria-devex: thanks — good call. I also noticed our SDK's stream helper returns an async generator proxy that yields from `client.stream(...)` which might swallow cancellation. I'll try changing the helper to expose the raw async generator and add explicit close on timeout.

devin-sdk: fwiw we had a similar CI flake where `httpcore` got downgraded by another dep (transport plugin). `pipdeptree` helped track it down. You can also run `pip check` after install to spot broken deps.

maria-devex: trying the changes now: export requirements, pin `httpx==0.23.3`, add `types-httpx==0.23.3`, and tweak the helper. will report back in ~20m. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Build 8421 — test-suite — FAILED (flaky-tests). See https://ci.company/8421 — triggered by push by maria-devex

maria-devex: (follow-up) the fix worked locally. CI still failed once but the failure was a different test that hit a network timeout. the streaming hang is gone after exposing raw generator and adding `await gen.aclose()` on cancel. My plan: open a tiny PR that pins httpx/types-httpx in our extras, add the `asyncio.wait_for` guard in tests, and include a CHANGELOG note about the stream helper behavior. Anyone object?

samir-ml: sounds good. maybe add a note in SDK guide about event loop expectations (pytest-asyncio vs anyio/uvloop). saved a future search for us.

alex-eng: +1, include the `poetry export` step in CI docs so reviewers don't forget.

linh: +1 — and add a type-ignore only if you have to; prefer matching stubs.

maria-devex: thanks all, opening PR now. will ping again if CI still flaps.
